text: The primary key, the two indexes and the Field IDs of the 7 standard columns of proceeds are named at merge under the platform naming convention: the key on id, the unmatched-list index on matched_to and received_date, the case index on case_id and received_date, and the standard-column Field IDs carried by the one dictionary's seed.
why: TSD P8 T3.1 gives the columns and T3.0 lists the standard columns with no Field ID, and no source in the read set gives a key name, an index name or an index column order.
read: TSD P8 T3.0, T3.1; legacy RWB-E1-001 section 13
confirm: ACE team, with the solution architect
impact: One key and two indexes; the column set, the types and the lengths are unchanged and no business value moves.

text: P8's share of the 92-table estate is the one table proceeds, and payment_match_rule is not created in rwb_payment: the match rules are rows of a rule package of rwb-decision under D-RCV-36 T10.
why: The Ownership Map gives P8 one table and the matching-rule story records the rule table as retired, while TSD P8 T3.1 still defines it.
read: _work/msr/context/P8.md (Tables (1) proceeds); RWB P8 E2027 APP s11; TSD P8 T3.1
confirm: Solution architect, with the P8 business analyst
impact: One table in the schema; no rule table, no rule row and no reference load of a rule in this service.

text: The two read paths of the table are the unmatched and matched list of a business date and the receipts of one case, and the index columns are chosen for them; the field lists, panels and states of SCR-28 and SCR-29 stay with the screen stories.
why: The operation gives the query parameters and the FSD gives the two screen names with no field list, so the read paths must be settled at design time.
read: TSD P8 T-A.2 (API-P8-001); FSD P8 Screens
confirm: Solution architect, with the P8 screen stories
impact: Two indexes and a plan check; no screen is built here and no field is added to the table.

text: The field rows of proceeds are declared in this story as a build artefact, handed to the one dictionary's seed of RWB-P1-E1001-APP through the Change Register, and proved matched by the conformance test; the service writes no dictionary row and reads no rwb_source_data table at run time.
why: The dictionary is one dictionary over the estate and is held by P1, and DP-01 forbids a cross-schema write from this service.
read: RWB P1 E1001 APP s1; TSD P8 T3.1; Template and Rules R5.5 DP-01
confirm: Solution architect, with the P1 dictionary owner
impact: One handover per service schema; the dictionary stays one dictionary and the drift test runs in both directions.

text: case_id, treatment_id and account_payment_id are uuid values with no foreign key, so the three relationships of TSD P8 T3.3 are resolved through the owners' contracts and not by a join.
why: The three owners sit in other schemas and account_payment has left the estate, and the legacy rule holds that a link to another owner is a business key with no foreign key.
read: TSD P8 T3.3; legacy RWB-E1-001 AC1 and BR8; DP-01
impact: No cross-schema constraint; a case, a treatment and a payment reference are values and a bad reference is refused by the writing story, not by the database.

text: DP13 stays one data product with one catalog row: the money facts on the row are ACE's and the match is the Workbench's, both travel on the same row, and the wording of the catalog row is corrected by RWB-P1-E1001-APP under a new catalog version rather than split here.
why: The catalog row names ACE only and legacy BR3 requires one sentence naming both where a product holds both.
read: Legacy RWB-E1-001 section 13 (DP13) and BR3; RWB P1 E1001 APP s11
confirm: Business analyst, P8, with the data steward of DP13
impact: One product and one row; the catalog text changes in the P1 story and no second product is created for a match.

text: The six platform contracts the migration needs — the per-service Flyway sequence, the schema and login, the decision-record library, the parameters and reference-data libraries, the naming library and the gateway-bff route — are the service baseline and are carried in the preconditions and the fakes, so the metadata row Depends on (build) stays None and Ready to start stays Day 1.
why: The plan gives this story no H row, and the schema, the login and the sequence exist before any story of the service can migrate.
